info.description:
Nagisa 网盘后端 HTTP API。

## 认证
除下文列出的公开接口外，所有接口都需要在请求头携带 `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`。
访问令牌由 `POST /v1/auth/login` 签发；调用前请先用 `GET /v1/auth/config` 取得 RSA 公钥，
把密码用 RSA-OAEP(SHA-256) 加密后 base64 编码再发送，服务端不会接受明文密码。
受密码保护的文件夹需要额外的 `X-Node-Token` 请求头，由 `POST /v1/nodes/{node_id}/unlock` 签发。

公开接口：`AuthService.GetAuthConfig`、`AuthService.Login`、`AuthService.RefreshToken`、`ShareService.AccessShare`、`ShareService.ListShareChildren`、`ShareService.GetShareDownloadUrl`、`SystemService.GetSystemInfo`、`SystemService.HealthCheck`。

## 数据传输格式
请求与响应使用 protobuf 的规范 JSON 映射：
枚举使用名称（如 `"PERMISSION_UPLOAD"`），64 位整数使用字符串（如 `"size": "1048576"`），
`bytes` 字段使用 base64，`google.protobuf.Timestamp` 使用 RFC 3339 字符串，
`google.protobuf.FieldMask` 使用逗号分隔的 camelCase 路径字符串（如 `"description,visibility"`）。
字段名同时接受 camelCase（文档中的写法）与原始下划线写法，便于调用方平滑迁移。

## 错误
失败响应统一为 `{"code":401,"reason":"NETDISK_UNAUTHENTICATED","message":"..."}`。
`reason` 取自 `ErrorReason` 枚举，调用方应当按它分支，而不是解析 `message`。

## 授权模型
账号等级（`rank`）构成严格的全序：默认管理员 1000、管理员 500、普通用户 100、访客 10。
调用方只能管理等级严格低于自己的账号，并且只能授予自己拥有的权限。
节点访问按「账号权限上限 → 属主通行 → 显式拒绝 → 显式允许（含继承）→ 可见范围 → 文件夹密码」的顺序判定，
详见 `docs/permissions.md`。

## 原始字节绑定
`GET /v1/files/{node_id}/content`、`GET /v1/files/{node_id}/archive`、`PUT /v1/files/uploads/{upload_id}/parts/{part_number}/raw` 直接收发二进制内容，
授权由 URL 签名或访问令牌承担，详见各接口说明。

get.description: ListAuditLogs returns a page of audit entries, newest first by default.

parameters.description:
Optional. Maximum number of entries to return. Defaults to 20, capped at
 500.
parameters.name: pageSize

parameters.description:
Optional. The standard list filter.
 Supported fields:
    * `actor_id`
    * `actor_name`
    * `action` (i.e. `action:"node."` for a prefix match)
    * `target_type`
    * `target_id`
    * `success` (i.e. `success` for successful calls, `NOT success` for
      failed ones; `success=true` and `success=false` are also accepted)
    * `ip`
    * `created_at` range
parameters.name: filter

parameters.description:
Optional. Comma-separated ordering fields, in the AIP syntax where a
 descending field is written with a `desc` suffix (`order_by=created_at desc`).
 Supported fields: `created_at`, `action`, `actor_name`.
parameters.name: orderBy

get.description: GetAuditLog returns a single audit entry by id.
GetAuditSummary aggregates the trail by action, actor and day.

parameters.description: Optional. Start of the window. Defaults to 7 days before to.
parameters.name: from

parameters.description: Optional. End of the window. Defaults to now.
parameters.name: to

parameters.description: Optional. Restrict the aggregation to one action prefix.
parameters.name: actionPrefix

get.description:
GetAuthConfig returns the parameters the client needs before it can log
 in, including the RSA public key used to encode passwords. This endpoint
 is public.

本接口为公开接口，无需访问令牌。

post.description:
GuestLogin opens a read-only session for the built-in guest account
 without a password, so a client can show what guests may read straight
 away. The account's permission set is fixed and cannot be changed by
 anybody, and the reply carries an access token only: there is nothing to
 refresh, a client simply asks again when the token expires.
 Returns UNSUPPORTED when the deployment does not enable guest login.

本接口为公开接口，无需访问令牌。

Login exchanges an account name and an encoded password for an access
 token and a refresh token.
 Returns UNAUTHENTICATED when the account does not exist or the password
 does not match, and PERMISSION_DENIED when the account is disabled.

本接口为公开接口，无需访问令牌。

Logout revokes the supplied refresh token and, when revoke_all is set,
 every refresh token of the account.

get.description: GetCurrentUser returns the account behind the presented access token.

post.description:
ChangePassword replaces the caller's own password. The current password
 must be supplied and encoded the same way as on login. Every other refresh
 token of the account is revoked on success.

RefreshToken rotates a refresh token into a fresh token pair. The
 presented refresh token is revoked on success.
 Returns UNAUTHENTICATED when the token is unknown, revoked or expired.

本接口为公开接口，无需访问令牌。

get.description: ListSessions returns the caller's active refresh sessions.

parameters.description: Include sessions that are expired or revoked.
parameters.name: includeInactive

post.description: RevokeSession revokes one of the caller's own sessions by id.

UploadSmallFile stores a payload carried inside the request. Intended for
 files at or below the max_inline_size advertised by SystemService, which
 defaults to 4 MiB.
AbortUpload cancels a session and reclaims every staged part.

CompleteUpload verifies every declared part, assembles the object and
 commits the node in one transaction.
 Returns UPLOAD_INCOMPLETE when parts are missing or their sizes do not add
 up, PRECONDITION_FAILED when the checksum does not match, and
 NAME_CONFLICT when the destination name was taken meanwhile.

InitiateUpload opens a multipart upload session. When a session with the
 same parent, name and owner is still pending it is returned instead of a
 new one, which makes retries and resumes idempotent.

get.description: ListUploads returns the caller's upload sessions.

parameters.description: Optional. Restrict to one status.
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: Optional. Restrict to a destination folder.
parameters.name: parentId

post.description:
ConfirmUploadPart records the etag produced by a direct-to-storage part
 upload. Only meaningful in UPLOAD_MODE_PRESIGNED.

get.description: GetUpload returns one upload session, including the parts already stored.

ListUploadParts returns the parts of a session, which lets a client resume
 without re-sending completed parts.

parameters.description:
Optional. Only return parts with a number greater than this value, which
 keeps a resume handshake small.
parameters.name: fromPartNumber

put.description:
UploadChunk streams one part through the server. part_number is one-based
 and must not exceed UploadSession.total_parts. Content type is inferred
 from the parent session.

parameters.description: One-based part number.
parameters.name: partNumber

put.description:
与 `FileService.UploadChunk` 等价，但请求体是原始字节而不是 base64 字符串，浏览器可以直接把文件切片 PUT 上来，省去约三分之一的传输开销。

必须携带访问令牌，且只能是上传会话的拥有者或持有 storage_manage 权限的账号。Content-Length 必须与分片实际长度一致。

parameters.description: 上传会话 ID
parameters.name: upload_id

parameters.description: 分片序号，从 1 开始
parameters.name: part_number

get.description:
GetArchiveUrl returns a signed URL that streams a folder, or a file, as a
 zip archive. Large folders are streamed on the fly rather than materialised.

parameters.description: Name of the produced archive without the extension.
parameters.name: archiveName

get.description:
GetDownloadUrl returns a signed URL for the original bytes of a file
 node. In a presigned deployment the URL points at object storage, so the
 download never traverses this server. The URL encodes the node id, the
 caller, the expiry and the disposition, and is validated again when it is
 redeemed.

parameters.description: Requested lifetime in seconds. Clamped to the configured maximum.
parameters.name: expiresInSeconds

parameters.description: Serve inline instead of as an attachment.
parameters.name: inline

parameters.description: Override the file name offered to the client.
parameters.name: fileName

get.description:
GetPreviewUrl returns a signed URL for an inline preview or a thumbnail.
 Returns UNSUPPORTED when no preview can be produced for the mime type.

parameters.description: Return the thumbnail instead of the full preview.
parameters.name: thumbnail

get.description:
把文件夹整棵子树实时压缩为 zip 流式返回，不会在服务端产生临时对象；对单个文件节点则返回只含该文件的压缩包。

签名由 `GetArchiveUrl` 签发，规则与内容下载一致，`extra` 为压缩包名称。

parameters.description: 文件或文件夹节点 ID
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.description: 签名过期时间（Unix 秒）
parameters.name: exp

parameters.description: 签名值
parameters.name: sig

parameters.description: 签名对应的账号 ID
parameters.name: sub

parameters.description: 压缩包名称（不含扩展名）
parameters.name: extra

get.summary: 打包下载文件夹（原始字节绑定）

get.description:
按 `GetDownloadUrl` 返回的签名地址下载原文件。支持 `Range` 请求头，因此可以断点续传；响应会带上 `Content-Disposition`、`ETag` 与 `Accept-Ranges`。

授权完全由 URL 签名承担：`exp` 为过期时间戳，`sig` 为 HMAC 签名，`sub` 为发起者账号，`extra` 为 `inline` 或 `attachment`。签名绑定方法、路径、节点与过期时间，无法挪用到其它资源。

parameters.description: 文件节点 ID
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.description: 签名过期时间（Unix 秒）
parameters.name: exp

parameters.description: 签名值
parameters.name: sig

parameters.description: 签名对应的账号 ID
parameters.name: sub

parameters.description: `inline` 表示内联展示，`attachment` 表示下载
parameters.name: extra

parameters.description: 字节范围，例如 `bytes=0-1048575`
parameters.name: Range

206.description: 部分内容，与 `Range` 请求对应

get.summary: 流式下载原文件（原始字节绑定）

post.description: CopyNodes copies nodes, including folder subtrees, into another folder.

DeleteNodes moves nodes to the trash. The rows and the stored objects are
 retained until PurgeNodes or EmptyTrash. A deleted folder keeps its
 contents, and ListTrash shows it as one entry instead of flattening the
 subtree into the listing.

CreateFolder creates a folder. The folder may carry a description, a
 visibility, a password and, through SetNodeAcl, an allow/deny list.

get.description:
ListNodes returns the children of a folder, or the root listing when
 parent_id is empty. Set recursive to walk the whole subtree.

parameters.description: Folder to list. Empty lists the root level.
parameters.name: parentId

parameters.description:
Optional. Maximum number of nodes to return. Defaults to 20, capped at
 1000.
parameters.name: pageSize

parameters.description: Optional. Token from a previous response's next_page_token.
parameters.name: pageToken

parameters.description:
Optional. The standard list filter.
 Supported fields:
    * `name` (i.e. `name:"report"`)
    * `kind` (i.e. `kind=2`)
    * `mime_type` (i.e. `mime_type:"image/"` prefix match with `:`)
    * `extension`
    * `size` (i.e. `size>1048576`)
    * `owner_id`
    * `status` (i.e. `status=1`)
    * `created_at` and `updated_at` ranges
parameters.name: filter

parameters.description:
Optional. Comma-separated ordering fields, in the AIP syntax where a
 descending field is written with a `desc` suffix (`order_by=size desc,name`).
 Folders are always listed before files.
 Supported fields: `name`, `size`, `kind`, `mime_type`, `extension`,
 `created_at`, `updated_at`.
parameters.name: orderBy

parameters.description: Walk the whole subtree instead of a single level.
parameters.name: recursive

parameters.description: Maximum depth to descend when recursive is set. Zero means unlimited.
parameters.name: maxDepth

parameters.description: Include trashed children. Requires PERMISSION_TRASH_MANAGE.
parameters.name: includeTrashed

post.description:
MoveNodes moves nodes to another folder in one transaction. The operation
 is all-or-nothing: a single rejected node rolls the whole batch back.

get.description: SearchNodes performs a tree-wide search over names and descriptions.

parameters.description:
Substring matched against the name, case-insensitively. Empty matches
 everything.
parameters.name: query

parameters.description:
Optional. Restrict the search to a subtree. Empty searches the whole tree
 visible to the caller.
parameters.name: scopeNodeId

parameters.description: Optional. Restrict to a node kind.
parameters.name: kind

parameters.description: Optional. Restrict to a mime type prefix, for example "image/".
parameters.name: mimeType

parameters.description: Optional. Restrict to an owner account id.
parameters.name: ownerId

parameters.description: Optional. Minimum size in bytes, inclusive.
parameters.name: minSize

parameters.description: Optional. Maximum size in bytes, inclusive. Zero means unlimited.
parameters.name: maxSize

parameters.description: Optional. Only return nodes modified at or after this time.
parameters.name: updatedAfter

parameters.description: Optional. Only return nodes modified at or before this time.
parameters.name: updatedBefore

parameters.description: Match the query against the description instead of the name.
parameters.name: matchDescription

parameters.description:
Optional. Maximum number of nodes to return. Defaults to 20, capped at
 1000.
parameters.name: pageSize

parameters.description: Optional. Token from a previous response's next_page_token.
parameters.name: pageToken

parameters.description:
Optional. Comma-separated ordering fields, in the AIP syntax where a
 descending field is written with a `desc` suffix (`order_by=updated_at desc`).
 Supported fields: `name`, `size`, `updated_at`, `created_at`, `relevance`.
parameters.name: orderBy

post.description: EmptyTrash purges every trashed node visible to the caller.

get.description:
ListTrash returns the trashed nodes visible to the caller. Entries are
 listed one level at a time, so a deleted folder shows up without its
 contents: the top entry of every trashed subtree comes first, and
 original_parent_id walks into one of those folders.

parameters.description:
Optional. The standard list filter, same syntax as
 ListNodesRequest.filter plus `trashed_at` ranges.
parameters.name: filter

parameters.description:
Optional. Comma-separated ordering fields. Supported fields: `name`,
 `size`, `trashed_at`, `updated_at`.
parameters.name: orderBy

parameters.description:
Optional. List the trashed children of this folder instead of the top
 entry of every trashed subtree. The folder itself has to be in the trash,
 so a client walks the trash tree one level per call.
parameters.name: originalParentId

post.description:
PurgeNodes permanently deletes nodes and their stored objects. Requires
 PERMISSION_TRASH_MANAGE.
RestoreNodes restores nodes from the trash.

get.description:
GetNodeTree returns a folder subtree expanded to the requested depth in a
 single round trip.

parameters.description: Folder to expand. Empty expands the caller's root level.
parameters.name: rootId

parameters.description: Maximum depth to descend. Defaults to 1.
parameters.name: depth

parameters.description: Maximum number of children returned per folder. Defaults to 200.
parameters.name: pageSize

parameters.description:
Optional. The standard list filter, applied at every level. Same syntax as
 ListNodesRequest.filter.
parameters.name: filter

put.description:
UpdateNode applies a partial update to a node. Supported paths: `name`,
 `description`, `visibility`, `metadata`, `password`, `remove_password`,
 `parent_id`. Renaming or moving requires PERMISSION_EDIT on the node.

post.description: RestoreNodeVersion promotes an older version to be the current content.

get.description: GetNode returns a single node by id.

GetNodeAcl returns the ACL entries attached to a node together with the
 entries inherited from ancestors and the caller's effective permissions.
GetNodePath returns the breadcrumb from the root to the node.
GetNodeStats returns aggregate counters for the node subtree.

parameters.description: Node to summarise. Empty summarises the caller's whole tree.
parameters.name: id

post.description:
SetNodeAcl replaces the complete ACL of a node. Requires
 PERMISSION_ACL_MANAGE on the node.

UnlockNode exchanges a folder password for a short-lived node token that
 the client sends in the X-Node-Token header to reach the folder and its
 descendants. The password must be RSA-OAEP(SHA-256) encrypted and base64
 encoded, exactly like an account password.

get.description: ListNodeVersions returns the content history of a file node.

delete.description: DeleteNodeVersion drops one version and reclaims its stored object.

post.description:
AccessShare resolves a share token into the shared node and its first
 level of children. This endpoint is public. When the share is password
 protected and no valid access_token is supplied it returns
 NETDISK_NODE_LOCKED together with a password hint.

本接口为公开接口，无需访问令牌。

get.description: ListSharesByNode returns the shares attached to one node.

post.description:
ListShareChildren browses a shared folder. This endpoint is public and
 requires the access_token returned by AccessShare for protected shares.

本接口为公开接口，无需访问令牌。

CreateShare grants a capability over a node. Requires PERMISSION_SHARE on
 the node and PERMISSION_DOWNLOAD when the share may download.

GetShareDownloadUrl returns a signed URL for a node inside a share. This
 endpoint is public and honours the share capability set, its expiry, its
 password and its download budget.

本接口为公开接口，无需访问令牌。

get.description:
ListShares returns share links. Callers without PERMISSION_USER_MANAGE see
 only their own shares.

parameters.description:
Optional. The standard list filter.
 Supported fields: `node_id`, `owner_id`, `name`, `status`, `token`,
 `created_at` and `expires_at` ranges.
parameters.name: filter

parameters.description:
Optional. Comma-separated ordering fields. Supported fields: `name`,
 `created_at`, `updated_at`, `expires_at`, `download_count`, `view_count`.
parameters.name: orderBy

put.description:
UpdateShare changes the capability set, password, expiry or budget of an
 existing share.

get.description:
GetShare returns one share link by id. The caller must own the share or
 hold PERMISSION_USER_MANAGE.

HealthCheck reports whether the process can reach its dependencies. This
 endpoint is public.

本接口为公开接口，无需访问令牌。

parameters.description: Probe dependencies instead of only reporting process liveness.
parameters.name: deep

get.description:
GetSystemInfo returns the capabilities, limits and public auth parameters
 of this deployment. This endpoint is public.

本接口为公开接口，无需访问令牌。

post.description:
RunMaintenance triggers the housekeeping jobs: expiring stale upload
 sessions, releasing objects queued for deletion, reclaiming orphaned
 objects, expiring share links and recounting per-account usage.

get.description:
ListSystemSettings returns the runtime tunables that may be changed
 without a restart.

put.description:
UpdateSystemSettings writes runtime tunables. Values are validated against
 the documented bounds of each key.

get.description: GetStorageStats aggregates storage usage across accounts.

parameters.description: Number of largest consumers to return. Defaults to 10, capped at 100.
parameters.name: topOwners

post.description:
CreateUser provisions an account. The supplied rank must be lower than the
 caller's rank and the supplied permissions must be a subset of the
 caller's permissions. When role is omitted the preset of ROLE_GUEST is
 used, so an unconfigured account is read-only.
 Returns PERMISSION_DENIED when the caller cannot manage the requested
 rank or permission set, and ALREADY_EXISTS on a duplicate username.

get.description:
ListUsers returns a page of accounts. Requires PERMISSION_USER_MANAGE.

 Declared before GetUser on purpose: the HTTP router registers routes in
 declaration order, so `/v1/users/list` has to be claimed before the
 `/v1/users/{id}` wildcard, otherwise "list" is read as an account id and
 the request fails with INVALID_ARGUMENT.

parameters.description:
Optional. Maximum number of accounts to return. Defaults to 20, capped at
 200.
parameters.name: pageSize

parameters.description: Optional. Token from a previous response's next_page_token.
parameters.name: pageToken

parameters.description:
Optional. The standard list filter.
 Supported fields:
    * `username` (i.e. `username:"alice"`)
    * `nickname`
    * `email`
    * `role` (i.e. `role=2`)
    * `status` (i.e. `status=1`)
    * `rank` (i.e. `rank<500`)
    * `created_at` range
    * `last_login_at` range
parameters.name: filter

parameters.description:
Optional. Comma-separated ordering fields.
 Supported fields: `username`, `nickname`, `role`, `rank`, `status`,
 `used_bytes`, `created_at`, `updated_at`, `last_login_at`.
parameters.name: orderBy

parameters.description: Optional. Include accounts with USER_STATUS_DELETED.
parameters.name: includeDeleted

post.description:
ResetUserPassword sets a new password for another account and revokes
 every session of that account.

get.description:
ListPermissionCatalog returns every permission with its Chinese label,
 grouped by category. Available to every authenticated caller.

post.description:
SetUserPermissions replaces an account's permission set. The new set must
 be a subset of the caller's own permissions.

get.description:
ListRolePresets returns the built-in permission templates together with
 the rank bounds the caller may assign. This endpoint is available to every
 authenticated caller so account forms can render themselves.

GetUserStats returns storage counters for one account. A caller without
 PERMISSION_USER_MANAGE may only read its own counters.

parameters.description: Account id. The literal value "me" resolves to the calling account.
parameters.name: id

put.description:
UpdateUser applies a partial update. Only fields named in update_mask are
 written. role, rank, permissions and quota_bytes may only be changed by a
 caller that outranks the target and holds the matching permission.

delete.description:
DeleteUser soft deletes an account, revokes its sessions and moves its
 nodes to the trash. Requires PERMISSION_USER_MANAGE and a strictly higher
 rank.

parameters.description: Move the account's nodes to the trash instead of leaving them in place.
parameters.name: trashNodes

get.description:
GetUser returns one account. A caller without PERMISSION_USER_MANAGE may
 only read its own account.

parameters.description: Account id. The literal value "me" resolves to the calling account.
parameters.name: id

tags.description: 账号认证与会话管理：登录、刷新、退出、修改密码。除 GetAuthConfig 与 Login 外均需访问令牌。
tags.name: AuthService

tags.description: 账号管理：仅持有 user_manage 权限且等级严格高于目标的账号可以创建、修改、禁用、删除账号并分配权限。
tags.name: UserService

tags.description: 文件树：文件夹与文件统一为节点，共用描述、可见范围、访问名单与密码模型。
tags.name: NodeService

tags.description: 内容传输：分片上传、签名下载地址、预览与打包下载。
tags.name: FileService

tags.description: 分享链接：把节点以独立的能力集合发布给没有账号的访问者。AccessShare、ListShareChildren、GetShareDownloadUrl 为匿名接口。
tags.name: ShareService

tags.description: 审计日志：记录每一次状态变更及其结果，只增不改。
tags.name: AuditService

tags.description: 系统信息、存储统计、运行参数与维护任务。GetSystemInfo 与 HealthCheck 为匿名接口。
tags.name: SystemService
